{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders removed: {qa_mask.sum()}")
data = data[~qa_mask]

# Correct the population: only orders with status == 'completed' AND converted == 1
# Because 'converted == 1' is defined as 'completed checkout', but there are 21 refunded orders
# with converted == 1 — this is a data quality issue
completed_data = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['converted'] == 1)]

# Check the number of such orders
print(f"Number of valid completed checkouts (status == 'completed' and converted == 1): {len(completed_data)}")

# Check distribution of channels and customer segments
print("\nChannel distribution among valid completed checkouts:\n", completed_data['channel'].value_counts())
print("\nCustomer segment distribution among valid completed checkouts:\n", completed_data['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if any valid completed checkouts have revenue == 0
print("\nValid completed checkouts with revenue == 0:", (completed_data['revenue'] == 0).sum())"}
